findings.title: The verified NO-GO capacity artifact remains bypassable
findings.evidence: The retained offline conformance lifecycle accepts transport-capable callbacks and can invoke both count and inference effects after validating the frozen NO-GO capacity artifact.

findings.title: Terminal fragments are independently valid but not cross-bound
findings.evidence: Foreign authoring requests, replaced authored programs, replaced persisted answers, and foreign evaluator receipts can remain self-consistent and pass terminal verification.

findings.title: Retrieval and pair replay treat re-signing as provenance
findings.evidence: A mutated second query and a re-keyed pair can be accepted after recomputing their inner digests because verification lacks independently trusted run and schedule roots.

findings.title: The selected topology incompletely reimplements the moderate envelope
findings.evidence: Input, reasoning, and visible-output overages can pass because the selected receipt enforces only total output and does not consume the authoritative M9b.10 moderate receipt.

findings.title: Primary analysis accepts a caller-selected balanced population
findings.evidence: The analyzer accepts caller-provided expected case and population identities, allowing a balanced 168-case subset to be selected from a larger verified measurement pool.
